A destination for fantastic cross-country skiing fun

Winter sports with a Black Forest panorama

Cross-country skiing in the Black Forest Highlands

In the Black Forest Highlands, 140 cross-country ski trails (totalling around 900km) are groomed by cross-country skiers in winter. A true paradise for cross-country skiers and skaters! The entire trail network has been certified and standardised by the German Ski Association. Most of the trails are classic and also prepared for skaters. There are several huts and shelters for cross-country skiers along the way. To help you plan your cross-country trip, check out the snow report as well as the trail descriptions - it gives you a daily overview of snow depths and open trails.

Cross-country ski trails

In addition to small circular trails and challenging high-altitude trails, the 100 km long Schonach-Belchen cross-country ski trail and the 35 km long Hinterzarten-Schluchsee cross-country ski trail lead right through the heart of the Black Forest Highlands. Cross-country skiers can enjoy trails of varying lengths and difficulty levels that wind their way through the picturesque winter landscape of the Black Forest.

One of the most beautiful cross-country ski trails in Germany

Thurner trail

Whether in small stages or all at once - the Thurnerspur is one of the most beautiful trails in the Black Forest and offers both classic cross-country skiers and skaters a great winter sports experience. Depending on your preference, the 15.6 km circuit can be shortened to 8 km, 10 km or 12 km.

Cross-country skiing paradise for the ambitious

Nordic Center Notschrei

The Nordic Centre Notschrei offers perfectly groomed trails for all levels. From the small, easy 3.5 km circuit to the challenging 20 km route to the Stübenwasen mountain inn on the Feldberg for skating and classic. The Nordic Centre Notschrei is also a DSV National Support Centre for Nordic Skiing/Biathlon and therefore a competitive sports facility.
